item.title: Which Roles Use AI More Frequently in U.S. Workplaces? Leaders Report Higher Frequency, Gallup Survey Shows
item.description: by Andy Kemp. Edited by Asim BN.U.S. employees already using artificial intelligence (AI) in the workplace used it slightly more often in the fourth quarter of 2025 than in the prior quarter, continuing a gradual increase since 2023. The proportion of employees using AI daily has risen from 10% to 12%. Frequent use, defined as using AI at work at least a few times a week, has also inched up three percentage points to 26%.
